title: Monorepo Restructure — Portfolio V1 + V2
description: Restructure the flat repo into a monorepo with portfolio-v1/ (current site) and portfolio-v2/ (future redesign). Sanity CMS studio lives inside v1 but will be refactored into a shared package later.
goals: Move current portfolio project into portfolio-v1/ subdirectory
Create portfolio-v2/ skeleton for future redesign
Keep shared repo infrastructure at root (.github, .agents, docs, AGENTS.md)
All CI/CD workflows target portfolio-v1/ until v2 is ready
Sanity studio stays inside portfolio-v1/studio/ for now
No functional changes — pure file moves and path updates
non-goals: Moving Sanity studio to a shared package (future step)
Changing any application code or behavior

stories.title: Create portfolio-v1/ and portfolio-v2/ directories
stories.commitMessage: chore(root): create portfolio-v1 and portfolio-v2 directories

stories.title: Move all project files into portfolio-v1/
stories.description: Use git mv to move all project files (package.json, src/, studio/, public/, content/, scripts/, functions/, tests/, patches/, configs) into portfolio-v1/. This preserves git history.
stories.commitMessage: refactor(root): move current portfolio into portfolio-v1/

stories.title: Create minimal Next.js v2 skeleton
stories.description: Create portfolio-v2/ with minimal Next.js App Router structure: package.json, next.config.js, tailwind.config.ts, postcss.config.js, tsconfig.json, eslint.config.mjs, src/app/layout.tsx, src/app/page.tsx, src/app/globals.css, public/.gitkeep, README.md.

stories.title: Update all workflow working directories
stories.description: Update all 24 GitHub Actions workflows to use portfolio-v1/ as working directory. Add working-directory: portfolio-v1/ to all steps that run npm/pnpm commands. Keep deployment workflows pointed at v1 until v2 is ready.
tasks: Add working-directory: portfolio-v1 to all npm/pnpm steps
Keep studio deploy pointing to portfolio-v1/studio/
stories.commitMessage: ci(root): update all workflows to target portfolio-v1/

stories.title: Update AGENTS.md and README.md
stories.description: Update AGENTS.md to reflect new monorepo structure. Update README.md to describe both v1 and v2 projects.
stories.commitMessage: docs(root): update AGENTS.md and README.md for monorepo

stories.title: Update .gitignore for monorepo
stories.description: Update .gitignore to handle both portfolio-v1/ and portfolio-v2/ node_modules, .next, dist, coverage, etc.

risk-mitigation.git-history: Use git mv (not cp + rm) to preserve file history
risk-mitigation.ci-cd: Test workflows after path updates — one broken path = failed builds
risk-mitigation.sanity-studio: Studio lives inside v1 — no path changes needed for its internal imports
risk-mitigation.env-files: .env.local moves with v1 — developer must recreate if needed
